description: Post-Phase-6 structural ceiling with one intentional shared cinematic component for the internal intelligence portals. The total-file ceiling includes the reviewed Entity & DBA Resolution route from Issue #38, the Occupational Exposure & Service Fit Matrix route from Issue #40, the three focused Company Live Intelligence production files from Issue #42, the two focused Workers’ Compensation Source Coverage production files from Issue #44, the three focused Defense Base Act Intelligence production files from Issue #46, the four shared Source Governance production files from Issue #48, the four focused Unified Employer Workflow production files from Issue #50, the one substantive public-source employer brief orchestrator from Issue #52, the reviewed four-company Location Overlap intelligence route from PR #79, and the two focused Neon-backed DBA Data Hub production files from PR #91. PR #79 intentionally owns one route-scoped Leaflet glass-map style block so its luminous blend and tooltip rules stay isolated from unrelated maps; all other structural ceilings remain unchanged. Values may be lowered by later cleanup PRs but must not be increased without an explicit review explanation.
